name: Soujun Shiwa
source:
[url=/c219]Karin's[/url] cousin an [url=/c59791]Karon's[/url] younger sister. A really gentle and caring woman. Her appearance and manner hides her true strength. Ruurin is in charge of various duties so she accumulates stress easily.

She can't drink sake and she's a terrible singer. She cares a lot about her older sister and get angry at her for not taking military affairs seriously, which endangers her life.
